evidence.consoleErrors: Repeated WebSocket connection failures: 'WebSocket connection to ws://localhost:5173/ws failed: Connection closed before receiving a handshake response' (30+ occurrences)

assertions.issues: Backend server (port 3100) is not running. The task description states it was 'verified healthy' but it was unreachable throughout the entire test session. The R process is running on port 3101, and the Vite dev server is running on port 5173, but the Bun backend server that bridges the frontend to the R process is down. Without the backend, the REPL cannot send commands to R and no graph operations (add or delete nodes) are possible.

blockers.description: Backend server (Bun on port 3100) is not running. curl to http://localhost:3100/health returns connection refused. The frontend cannot establish WebSocket connection, REPL commands produce no output, and no graph operations are possible. Retried 5 times over 15 seconds and again after 20 seconds — backend never became available.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Retried health checks 6 times over ~35 seconds total. Did not attempt to restart the server per isolation rules (shared infrastructure — other workers may depend on it).

summary: Tested 1 assertion: 0 passed, 0 failed, 1 blocked (VAL-GUI-012: backend server on port 3100 is down, making all graph operations including node deletion impossible)
